<th class="th" colspan="1">6 Months Ended</th>
</tr>
<tr><th class="th"><div>Jun. 30, 2026</div></th></tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_DisclosureTextBlockAbstract', window );"><strong>Notes to Financial Statements</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_imri_GoingConcernAndLiquidityTextBlock', window );">Going Concern and Liquidity [Text Block]</a></td>
<td class="text">
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Note <em style="font: inherit;">2</em> </b>&#8211;<b> Liquidity</b> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The accompanying unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis, which contemplates the realization of assets and satisfaction of liabilities and commitments in the normal course of business.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">At each reporting period, the Company evaluates whether conditions or events raise substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern for <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> year after the date that the financial statements are available to be issued. In performing this evaluation, management considers the Company&#8217;s current financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, contractual obligations, and its ability to obtain additional financing if needed.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">For the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>, the Company incurred net losses of $25,138,772, and cash used for operating activities was $14,032,058. As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>, the Company had working capital of $29,105,091. Current liabilities include the current portions of the Company&#8217;s convertible notes (related party) and option liabilities, which are recorded at fair value in accordance with ASC <em style="font: inherit;">825</em> and ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815,</em> respectively, and their carrying amounts <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>differ significantly from the contractual principal and interest or other cash obligations associated with settling these instruments. See Note <em style="font: inherit;">7</em> for disclosure of the contractual principal and interest outstanding on the Company&#8217;s convertible notes (related party) as of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">Management has evaluated the principal conditions affecting the Company&#8217;s liquidity, including recurring operating losses, cash used for operating activities, and contractual obligations due within the next <em style="font: inherit;">12</em> months. Based on this evaluation management has concluded that the Company has sufficient liquidity to fund its operations and meet its obligations as they become due for at least the <em style="font: inherit;">12</em>-month period following the date the unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements are available to be issued.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <span></span>
</td>
